# AI Factory entry point

For repository-aware agent work, explicitly read root AGENTS.md and .factory/bootstrap.md before edits. Load the active task, assigned role, and scoped instructions for affected paths. These references require file access; a Markdown mention alone does not load the target. If the current Copilot surface cannot read files or run commands, request a context export and provide proposals without claiming local execution. Preserve task/worktree ownership and existing authorization. Write project documents in English. Shared repository files define the full workflow.
